task.objective: Triage CircleCI/check state after push ebd735871 for PR #245.

findings.evidence: gh pr checks 245 --repo jscraik/Agent-Skills --watch=false -> security/snyk (jscraik) fail: You have used your limit of private tests
findings.impacted_behavior: Merge readiness is blocked by an external security check failure.
findings.remediation: Re-run after Snyk quota resets or update the required-check policy if this check is no longer intended.

failures_or_blockers: security/snyk failed because the org exhausted private test quota.
Several GitHub Actions checks remain pending in the latest rollup.
improvement_opportunities: Differentiate external quota failures from repo-owned CI failures in the triage summary.
Document the next step for Snyk quota exhaustion.
strengths: Separated CircleCI success from the separate security check failure.
Kept the run read-only and evidence-backed.
validation_evidence: git rev-parse / git status / git remote get-url origin
accountability.next_action: Wait for Snyk quota availability or update required-check policy if the private-test limit is intentional.

useful_findings: Confirmed the CircleCI workflow passed while a separate security check failed.
avoided_false_positive: Did not report the stale in-progress rollup from the earlier PR view as the final state.
positive_performance.evidence_quality: Live CLI check output with exact failure text and status URLs.
positive_performance.followed_scope: Read-only triage only; no file edits outside artifacts.
reusable_learning: Use gh pr checks as the freshest triage surface when rollups and PR views disagree.
